name: Giatec
description:
Connect Claude directly to your Giatec Platform account to query mix designs, delivery tickets, IoT sensor data, and project information using natural language — no need to switch between dashboards or run manual reports.

Key Features:

Mix Design Analytics — Search, compare, and analyze concrete mix designs across your account, including material composition, cost, CO₂ footprint, and both designed-target and delivered-performance metrics.
MixPilot IoT Data — Pull real-time and historical data from in-transit trucks, gateways, and sensors, including slump readings, ticket-level time-series data, and live delivery status.
Delivery Ticket Search — Look up and filter delivery tickets, trips, and trucks across your fleet with flexible field-level queries.
Test Sample & Strength Data — Query grouped test samples and specimen break results for strength analysis and quality control.
Project & Customer Management — Access project, customer, and supplier records, and create or update them as needed.
Materials Library — Search, create, and manage materials, material groups, and suppliers directly from Claude.
Submittals — Create, retrieve, and manage submittals, templates, and revisions without leaving your conversation.
Giatec Knowledge Base — Ask product and platform questions and get answers sourced from Giatec's own documentation.
Multi-Account Support — Authenticate and switch between accounts for users with access to multiple Giatec accounts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Giatec to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Giatec to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.giatecscientific.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Giatec MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Giatec lists 58 MCP tools, including auth_list_accounts, auth_logout, auth_select_account, auth_whoami, giatec_knowledge_ask, giatec_knowledge_fetch_image, giatec_knowledge_search, giatec_redesign_mix, mixpilot_get_device, mixpilot_get_gateway_measurements, mixpilot_get_intransit_ticket, and mixpilot_get_slump_by_ticket.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Giatec?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Giatec in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Giatec requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Giatec is developed by Giatec Scientific Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
